source.creator: Julian Goldie SEO

normalization.overview: The finding. A local JARVIS-style assistant combines downloaded language models, Markdown notes, embedding-based retrieval, speech and tools. The demonstration shows a plausible integration, not an independently qualified offline architecture.
normalization.whyItMatters: The limitation. Running inference on a private machine does not prove application-wide network isolation, retrieval accuracy, durable memory consistency, safe tool authorization or reproducible performance.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: The recommendation. Treat locality as an architectural advantage, then run bounded network, retrieval, memory, tool and performance acceptance tests before granting consequential operational authority.
normalization.falsification: Block outbound traffic after dependency download; evaluate known-answer retrieval, restart/correct/delete memory, denied tool actions and repeatable latency and rate measurements.
normalization.freshness: November 5, 2026 07:41 video; private verified media pack with machine Whisper timestamped transcript. Claims were not independently replicated.
